items.headline: Things to do in the Capital Region this weekend: Nov. 20-22
items.excerpt: The weekend is almost here! From the Schenectady County Holiday Parade to Saratoga Comic Con to Deck the Hall-bany, there are quite a few things happening on November 20, 21 and 22.

items.headline: Victim of fatal Northway rollover crash in Clifton Park identified
items.excerpt: New York State Police confirmed that the victim of a fatal rollover crash on the Northway has been identified.

items.headline: 1 dead, 1 seriously injured in Canajoharie crash
items.excerpt: One person has died and another was seriously injured after a four-car crash on the Thruway near exit 29 in Canajoharie. The crash happened on Wednesday around 6:30 p.m. on the Thruway heading eastbound.
